items.resolution: passed: exact-v1 §4.5–§4.7 and §5 support the deadline-aware request-DAG, local queue and adaptive-quality mechanism. The integrated paragraph keeps request/stage readiness, deadline, backpressure and batching under INFER-SCHEDULING, states the measurement boundary, preserves the static-pipeline coexistence case, and hands off execution to the model instance without duplicating the multimodal-model chapters.

passed: exact-v1 §IV-A–§IV-E and §VI support persistent on-chip recurrent state, the fused update dataflow and the capacity/operator-coverage boundary. The paragraph correctly places state layout/lifetime/commit in the execution plan, does not generalize FPGA ratios to GPU, and preserves the generic external-memory path when state does not fit or the model changes frequently.

passed: exact-v1 §3.2, §4 and §6 support predictor→scaler→placer control, expert replica lifecycle and placement under memory/communication constraints. The Books text preserves router ownership of token-to-expert semantics, bounds the serverless evidence, and retains resident experts for stable-hot, weak-network or strict-tail workloads.
